summary: Reviewed the inline plan bytes only: this seat was instructed not to call any filesystem or shell tool, so the line-number citations in sections 0-2 (api.py, judgments.py, emit.py, pyrel_rules.py, extract/service.py, model/_includes.py, model/flattening.py) and the test names in H8-H9 were not re-read at 260c4337 and no citation mismatch is asserted here. All concerns are internal to the plan: a rule/criterion contradiction (R0.6 versus IR2-C5), two different model digests introduced by IR1 without stating which one a receipt is verified against, IR1-C7's unstated byte-identity premise, an unfalsifiable either/or criterion (IR3-C3), criteria that consume fixtures section 3 never produces, a parity claim (IR2-C2) wider than R0.4 and unsupported by any harvested observation, a missing refusal criterion for the export routes IR3 changes, and several test-accounting gaps between sections 3, 4, 6 and 9. Structure, ordering and the acyclic claim in section 3 are otherwise consistent, and sections 5, 7 and 8 agree with the goal predicates.
